newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble to build Missouri plant.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble to build Missouri plant.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said Wednesday it will increase its tissue and towel manufacturing capacity by investing $350 million to build a production facility in Cape Girardeau, Mo.
The facility will be constructed as an expansion to P&G's diaper plant in Cape Girardeau and will add at least 350 jobs, the company said.
The Cape Girardeau plant currently employs 1,170 people.
P&G said it selected the Cape Girardeau site to take advantage of existing synergies and because of its proximity to growing markets.
The company will build two new paper machines and associated converting equipment at the plant, which will together add about 130,000 tons of annual capacity.
The first machine will begin operating by the first half of the year 2000, with the second starting up between six and 18 months later, P&G said.
